description:
Vital Recorder is open with the surgical case file '0001.vital' loaded. The current view shows only default waveform tracks. Your task is to add three specific physiological parameter tracks to the waveform display to monitor the patient's hemodynamics and depth of anesthesia.

Required Tracks to Add:
1. Solar8000 / ART_MBP (Mean Arterial Blood Pressure)
2. Primus / ETCO2 (End-Tidal CO2)
3. BIS / BIS (Bispectral Index)

Steps:
1. Open the track addition interface (right-click on the track area or use the 'Add Track' menu).
2. Navigate the device/parameter tree to find the specific parameters listed above.
3. Add each track to the display.
4. Verify that the new tracks appear and display waveform or numeric data.

The final display must show these three tracks alongside any existing ones.
